Leading Yonsei University
In response to the global trend that requires advanced advanced materials engineering technology, education, experimentation, and research on the entire process of basic, in-depth, and application from the theory and design of metals, ceramics, electronics, and biomaterials to manufacturing and characteristic evaluation and application Through this, we foster advanced research and technical personnel with academic-technical diversity, expertise, creativity and leadership in related industries, and conduct education and research that leads science and technology in this field.

Merit 01
Special professors
Excellent professors with rich academic and industrial experience and It is made up of experts. with them in several fields We nurture talented people who can comprehensively understand and analyze, and provide innovative solutions and strategies to our society.
Merit 02
Leadership
MSE provides the necessary knowledge, skills and experience to research innovative new materials engineering.
In particular, it will be the best customized course for those who are creative, adventurous, and lead new change.
Merit 03
Global network
MSE is forming a global network with various domestic and foreign companies, government agencies, and major research institutes. By using this network, you will be able to build outstanding experiences and careers in innovation, technology management, and start-up fields.
